cases.prompt: I want Claude Desktop on my laptop to search and read my local markdown notes folder. Python, just for me, no network. Tools: search_notes(query, limit) and read_note(path). Build it.
expected: Uses stdio transport for a local server and states logs go to stderr, never stdout
Contracts for search_notes and read_note as read side-effect class with additionalProperties false and a capped limit with pagination
Restricts read_note to the notes folder (path traversal check) and lists a test for it
Explains adding the server to the Claude Desktop MCP config (command + args)

cases.prompt: TypeScript MCP server for our multi-tenant CRM, hosted centrally for all customer workspaces. Tools: search_contacts, get_contact, update_deal_stage. OAuth via our existing IdP.
expected: Streamable HTTP transport with OAuth 2.1 resource-server pattern; tokens validated per request and scopes mapped to tools
Tenant and principal derived from the auth context, never from tool arguments
update_deal_stage classed as write with an idempotency statement; search_contacts paginated and capped
Rate limits per principal and origin validation for the remote endpoint

cases.prompt: Our payments team wants an MCP tool so the support agent can issue refunds: refund_payment(payment_id, amount, reason). Design the contract.
expected: Classes refund_payment as irreversible and uses a two-phase prepare/commit pattern
Requires an idempotency key and a human approval (HITL) before commit
Input schema with additionalProperties false, amount limits, and structured error codes such as CONFLICT and FORBIDDEN

cases.prompt: We want an MCP server for the underwriting team: the model should be able to look up a policy by number; users should be able to attach any of our 300 guideline PDFs to a chat; and there's a 'draft renewal letter' workflow people pick by name. How should we model these?
expected: Policy lookup as a tool (model-invoked), guideline PDFs as resources (user/app-selected by URI), the renewal-letter workflow as a prompt
Gives a narrow verb_object tool name and contract for the lookup
Flags the name (should be verb_object snake_case, narrow) and the vague description (what, when, when-not)
Requires additionalProperties false, described/enumerated properties, and pagination with caps (truncated, total, next_cursor)
Replaces raw exception text with structured error codes (e.g. INVALID_ARGUMENT, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL) and no stack traces to the model
Flags that a free-form table argument is effectively a generic data executor

cases.prompt: We're adding read_inbox_message to our MCP server so the assistant can summarise customer emails. Anything special about this tool?
expected: Labels the returned email content as untrusted (untrusted_output in the contract) and delimits it
Adds an injection corpus to the security tests for this tool's output
Caps output size and redacts secrets/PII per policy

cases.prompt: Our MCP server for inventory lookups is built. What tests do I need before we roll it out to other teams?
expected: Contract tests: schemas validate and extra properties are rejected

Protocol tests: initialize handshake, tools/list, tools/call via the SDK test client or MCP Inspector, plus a security module (injection, oversized inputs)
